description: Turn recurring charges into tracked bills — **several in one call**. An entry either names a `merchant` from fixed_expense_candidates, in which case the charge, cadence and category come from the detector unless overridden, or gives a `name` and an `expected_amount` for a bill the ledger cannot see, like an annual premium paid by standing order elsewhere. **Dry-runs by default**: it returns what it would track and writes nothing until called again with commit true. Confirming the same merchant twice updates the row already covering it rather than adding a second. The document is copied to a timestamped .bak before anything is written.

commit.description: Default false. False previews the batch; true writes it.

ending_at.description: The newest month of that window, as YYYY-MM. Default this month.

expenses.description: One entry per bill. Up to 100 in a call.

cadence.description: One of MONTHLY, BIMONTHLY, QUARTERLY, YEARLY, IRREGULAR. Defaults to what the detector inferred.

category_id.description: Overrides the category most of its rows are already in. Ids from `category_tree`.

expected_amount.description: The whole recurring charge in major units, positive — a yearly premium is the year’s figure, not a twelfth of it. Defaults to the detector’s median.

is_discretionary.description: True for a bill that could be cut — a subscription, not rent. Fixed and cuttable are different axes.

merchant.description: The normalized merchant, exactly as `fixed_expense_candidates` printed it.

name.description: What to call it. Defaults to the merchant as written. Required when there is no merchant.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

window_months.description: The lookback used to re-find the candidates, matching the one you listed them with. Default 3.

name: track_fixed_expenses
title: Track recurring charges as bills
